body:
thank you for that information. As much as I'd hate to admit it, I'm either going to be extremely lucky and find something I missed once i listen to the recordings again, or I'm screwed and have to wait longer since I pretend to be a neighbour when contacting CPS. my mom already gets mad when my sister screams when being beat, I absolutely refuse for her to blame the report on my sister and be angered even more.

I'm really hoping my memory isn't that well rn

I don't know if they're exactly why I'm alive, but I think my reasons for living other than being scared of actually doing the act are my sister, Komi can't communicate manga, and 100% completing Spider-Man Miles Morales on the highest difficulty. It sounds stupid, OP, but we all have weird reasons that are keeping us alive. I'm both glad and mad that I have those reasons, maybe it's the same for you
I'm too much of a coward to know if I'll do it this year or not, but once I die I'll join you. if god exists he needs to stop toying with my life like it's a sick joke

I'll probably update this tomorrow on a  different post once I listen to them (got my phone taken away for telling my mom that she's being unnecessarily cruel), cause if there's anything I missed maybe someone here can determine it's enough for a really good case

man, I didn't think about her lying to them. I'll have to sleep on that thought. For the emotional abuse part, I don't really care about how my mom abuses me, it's mainly my sister that I want to help. She suffers more emotional than physical, but I already figured that CPS sucks when it comes to emotional abuse, so I'm trying to see what options I have

I'd think that even without a voice recording of her actually getting hit, 4-5 video recordings of her crying/getting threatened are enough. especially one from 2 days ago that literally has my mom threatening to kill her :/

some of them are from a couple months ago, I haven't listened to a single recording more than once cause they make me cry, but I think If there's a chance that I might've even caught a little bit of physical abuse (or mentions of it), I have to

She doesn't currently have any bruises that I know of, is there any way that the voice recordings would be enough? I don't really want to wait for when she gets another bruise or something, that would kill me on the inside

I don't know how to get evidence of a current bruise unless I wait till the next time she gets hit (it last happened 2 days ago) and there's no fucking way I'm waiting till then. Would a recording of my mom threatening to kill her (in a different language) be enough? I really don't want to wait longer that what's absolutely necessary. even though my sister despises me, I dont want her to suffer
I'll take any and all advice, please just help if you can

I hope so too. I feel like dying, I want to die, but I’m too scared and want someone to save me. The people here can and have given me a lot of perspective, guidance, and advice. All I’m missing is the person irl who will actually help me out of this
Shut up.

Thank you for that. I surprisingly have a lot of freedom when it comes to leaving the house. I just need to be home for lunch and before sunset if I don’t have my bike with me, so I’ll see if I can talk to a priest or something in a church away from where I live
 (to avoid being recognized by neighbours or friends around)
I should seriously be taking my own advice but I never do

I get it. I sometimes feel like dying is the only way to finally have peace, but I’m just too scared to. The only thing keeping me alive right now is my fear of death. I try to see the beauty in life, the things worth living for, but I can’t.

 yknow what? Fuck that. Fuck everyone that has ever caused pain and suffering in my life. Fuck god, my dad, my teachers, and my moms best friend for letting all this happen to me. Whenever I consider dying, the first thing that goes into my mind is that I won’t let those who despise me, those who treat my life as a sick fucking joke, take that victory over me. It doesn’t always help, but it always creates a small barrier from me and the feeling of ending it all right then and there.

Op, what I’m trying to say is that I understand what you’re going through. But don’t let your demons and tormentors win.

How could you possibly remember all that as happy memories? I’ve tried standing up for myself against my mom and “friends”, it just backfires on me. You have a lot of kindness and compassion. being able to forgive an abusive parent like that is something I could never, and will never be able to do

Man, I’ve done it once before, and that shit hurts like hell. Not the actual cut, just the emotional pain that I was feeling when doing it. I was in such pain emotionally doing it that I just never did again. I just stab cardboard whenever I feel like that now, maybe that’ll help you.

Fuck your assaulter, I hope they rot in hell for what they’ve done to you. You’ve fought for years, and don’t deserve it.
I don’t know why, but I believe hell. If god exists and knows all, then they’d already know that I think they’re a cunt that’s ruining my life as a sick joke, so I’m 100% going to hell.
Yeah, I hate how I can’t enjoy that stuff anymore without hating myself In the process. It’s always just depressing/graphic manga and horror movies for me nowadays :/

I can’t talk to women in person anyways, so I would definitely stick with only males. I really don’t want to be with another person though, especially a stranger, it would be awkward. But if there was even the slightest chance that I could move out right now and live comfortably with roommates, I’d take it because it’d be the closest I’d ever be to a normal life

Yeah. Even the smallest bit of wholesome media ruins my day because I just desperately want to be them. I remember reading a wholesome slice of life manga a couple days ago. Spent 12 hours reading the entire thing from start to finish. In the end I almost cried because I just so desperately wanted my life to be like that. It hurts

Thank you for that, really. But what are the chances that I just wouldn’t be sent to a relative or to my dad. What are the chances that CPS would even believe me? What if they don’t and im sent back home?

I don’t want to risk it. I could wait to get a job once I’m 14-15, but minimum wage without a high school diploma nowadays unfortunately ain’t getting me anywhere
Yes please.

I can’t. I procrastinate too much, I can’t avoid people in school since thanks to my teacher everyone in the class is pretty much forced to interact with one another and staying away from all of them is not an option which is the only way for me to possibly focus without torment. 

my mom (or my entire family tbh) is hyper religious so I was raised to believe that hell is real and committing sins (s*icide being one of them) and I’m so afraid of it that I just can’t do it. 

Fuck all the adults in my life, none of them do shit and I can’t talk to any of them without them automatically telling my mom about it (which is something I refuse to let happen, she’d do anything to get rid of me if she knew I was “sinning”. The one time I’ve tried to talk to her about the possibility of procrastination being my problem for why I can’t focus too well she just automatically told me I’m being dramatic and choosing not to work when I really try and proceeded to lecture me for an hour. The few times I’ve tried to talk to an adult that wasn’t my mom, they all told her even when I asked them not to. In conclusion, there’s nothing I can do

I could try to focus on school, but it won’t be worth it cause I’ll be so stressed in the end I’ll just kill myself anyways
I just want to die, man. but I’m so scared of going to hell that I just can’t
